feedback: `blocker_moved` deviates from the documented expression: it scans the whole grid for any cell adjacent to a door that lacks a ball, which is not the intended semantics. The task requires the specific cell in front of the door — the ball's starting position `(dx - 1, dy)` — to be ball-free. With the candidate's check, removing a ball anywhere near a door (or any other free cell adjacent to a door, which includes the door's other side) can make `blocker_moved` true, incorrectly firing the reward transition even when the actual blocking ball remains in place. Also the logic only checks the cell horizontally adjacent to the door, ignoring vertical adjacency, which fails when the door is oriented vertically (key cell at `(dx, dy - 1)`), misreporting `blocker_moved`. The code notes explicitly state the ball starts at `(dx - 1, dy)` and that the expression should check `env.grid.get(dx - 1, dy)`. Other propositions are fine, but `blocker_moved` must be corrected.
